title: 비슷하게 생긴 글자: ㄹ/ㄷ, ㅁ/ㅇ, ㅏ/ㅓ
objective: By the end, you can tell ㄹ from ㄷ, ㅁ from ㅇ, and ㅏ from ㅓ at a glance.
summary: Learn to tell apart three pairs of look-alike Hangul letters.

task.title: Tell the letters apart
task.line: Look closely at the shape of each letter, then choose or write the right letter or word.

words.exampleMeaning: I can see a bridge over there.

letters.sound: ㄷ [d/t] is an open box made of three lines. ㄹ [r/l] adds a zigzag on top.
letters.as: ㄷ like 'd' in 'do'; ㄹ like the quick 't' in American 'water'.

letters.sound: ㅁ [m] is a square. ㅇ is a circle and silent before a vowel.
letters.as: ㅁ like 'm' in 'mom'; ㅇ here has no sound at all.

letters.sound: Short stroke points right: ㅏ [a]. Points left: ㅓ [eo].
letters.as: ㅏ like 'a' in 'father'; ㅓ like 'u' in 'cut', lips not rounded.

exercises: Write ㄹ or ㄷ. Which one is in the second syllable? ① 바다 (sea) ② 나라 (country) ③ 구두 (shoes)
Choose the right spelling: ① forehead: 이마 / 이아 ② child: 마이 / 아이 ③ tree: 나무 / 나우
Choose the word that matches the romanization: ① geomi (spider): 가미 / 거미 ② ama (maybe): 아마 / 어마 ③ beoseu (bus): 바스 / 버스
Each word has one wrong letter. Write the word correctly: ① 거수 (singer) ② 이오 (aunt) ③ 소디 (sound)
answers: ① ㄷ ② ㄹ ③ ㄷ
① 이마 ② 아이 ③ 나무
① 거미 ② 아마 ③ 버스
① 가수 ② 이모 ③ 소리
